title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with solid Wall‑of‑Sound ambience; standout Dark Star→Eyes→Stella Blue suite and fiery Cumberland Blues make this a classic ’73 show.
ai_review.review: The June‑30‑1973 performance shines thanks to Jerry’s soaring lead work, Keith’s electric‑piano interplay on the marathon Eyes, and a tight Dark Star that flows into a soulful Stella Blue.  The soundboard capture is generally crisp and full of the famed Wall‑of‑Sound ambience, though a few listeners note a slight hiss and occasional mix imbalance where Jerry sits low in the front‑of‑mix.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 ★, praising both the musical performance and recording quality; only a handful mention minor mix or balance issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp Wall‑of‑Sound ambience with nice clarity; listeners note slight hiss, occasional drop‑out from Dark Star, and a few comments that Jerry’s guitar/voice can sit low in the mix.

poor_songs: Beat It On Down The Line (vocals off‑key)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A mellow first set that builds into a powerful second‑set suite Dark Star→Eyes→Stella Blue, with smooth transitions and an especially tight Dark Star/Eyes segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Top form on lead guitar; searing solos on Cumberland Blues and Stella Blue; voice quiet but soulful; some reviewers note his mix level is low at times.
band_member_comments.Phil: Classic, solid bass work highlighted by deadreview as ‘Phil’s classic bass.’
band_member_comments.Bob: A few listeners wanted more Bob in the front‑of‑mix, especially on vocal harmonies.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's electric piano shines—groovy work early, tight interplay with Jerry on Eyes, and overall strong contribution throughout.
